q-37960.name: Question 1
q-37960.problem: What is the quotient of ${x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+x+1$ divided by ${x}^{2}+2x+1?$
q-37960.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,x \\  & {x}^{2}+2x+1\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+x+1\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $x,$ and

- the remainder is $1.$

q-38029.problem: What is the quotient of $48{x}^{3}+16{x}^{2}-12x-4$ divided by $12{x}^{2}-2x-2?$
q-38029.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,4x+2 \\  & 12{x}^{2}-2x-2\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,48{x}^{3}+16{x}^{2}-12x-4\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{48{x}^{3}-8{x}^{2}-8x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,24{x}^{2}-4x-4 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{24{x}^{2}-4x-4}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $4x+2,$ and

- the remainder is $0.$

q-37940.name: Question 4
q-37940.problem: What is the remainder when $3{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-18x-1$ is divided by $3{x}^{2}-8x-2?$
q-37940.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,x+2 \\  & 3{x}^{2}-8x-2\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,3{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-18x-1\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{3{x}^{3}-8{x}^{2}-2x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,6{x}^{2}-16x-1 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{6{x}^{2}-16x-4}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $x+2,$ and

- the remainder is $3.$

q-104246.name: Question 5
q-104246.problem: What is the quotient of $3{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-x-1$ divided by ${x}^{2}+x+1?$
q-104246.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,3x-5 \\  & {x}^{2}+x+1\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,3{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-\phantom{0}x-1\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{3{x}^{3}+3{x}^{2}+3x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-5{x}^{2}-4x-1 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{-\,5{x}^{2}-5x-5}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,x+4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $3x-5,$ and

- the remainder is $x+4.$

q-104250.name: Question 8
q-104250.problem: What is the remainder when $-2{x}^{4}+{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+1$ is divided by $2{x}^{2}-x+5?$
q-104250.worked_solution:
Notice that the dividend is missing the $x$ term. So, we first rewrite it by including the missing term with a coefficient of zero, as follows:

$$
-2{x}^{4}+{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+1=-2{x}^{4}+{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+0x+1
$$

Now, using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,-{x}^{2}+1 \\  & 2{x}^{2}-x+5\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,-2{x}^{4}+{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+0x+1\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,{-\,2{x}^{4}+{x}^{3}-5{x}^{2}}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,2{x}^{2}+0x+1 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{2{x}^{2}-x+5}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,x-4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $-{x}^{2}+1,$ and
